name: cache-countdown
description: Prompt-cache meter above the prompt: hit %, read/wrote/new tokens, a TTL countdown and advice (warm, soon, expired, miss, off). /cache opens a pane with a countdown bar, the last request's stacked bar and a per-turn table; /cache setup is a settings wizard. Configurable tick rate: once a minute by default, every second in the final minute.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto follows Claude Code's rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, promptCacheTtl setting, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 1h on a Claude subscription / 5m otherwise) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

warnSeconds.title: Warn before expiry (s)
warnSeconds.description: Final stretch: inside these last seconds the band turns red and the countdown ticks every finalTickSeconds

tickSeconds.title: Countdown step (s)
tickSeconds.description: How often the countdown updates while more than warnSeconds is left. 60 shows '59m' and wakes once a minute; 1 shows m:ss and wakes every second

finalTickSeconds.title: Final countdown step (s)
finalTickSeconds.description: How often the countdown updates inside the last warnSeconds

compactAtTokens.title: Large context (tokens)
compactAtTokens.description: From this prompt size up, an expired cache suggests /compact (or /clear)

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show the meter as a row above the prompt

status.title: Status line entry
status.description: Also pin a short entry (hit % and countdown) under the prompt

toast.title: Toast near expiry
toast.description: Toasts as the cache is about to expire, at the toastAt marks, once each per cache entry

toastAt.title: Toast at (seconds left)
toastAt.description: Comma-separated seconds left at which a toast fires, e.g. 60,10,5,1. Keep marks at least 3 s apart: Claude Code drops a toast within 2 s of the previous one

toastMinTokens.title: Toast only from (tokens)
toastMinTokens.description: Prompts smaller than this never toast: a lapsed small cache is cheap to rebuild. 0 toasts always
